content: Bɛkɩklɩ́ɩ Yesu Nwunsʋ

Ilesi nkenyɔ́ Yudafɔ abʋgyi Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ pʋ́ Bodobodo Mátúhɛ́Nkɛ. Alɩ brɛ́ ámʋtɔ Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ bodunká ɔkpa ánɩ́ bɔ́tsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ kɩ́tá Yesu ŋáintɔ, mɔ́ mʋ kokooko.
Támɛ bɛblɩ́ bɛɛ, “Megyí Katsʋn Nkɛ ánfɩtɔ abɔ́mɔ mʋ, mɛ́nɩ kpokiti mɛ́ɛda ɔmá ámʋtɔ.”
Ofobí Fánfáánfán Pʋwʋ́lɩ́ Yesu

Brɛ́á Yesu bʋ Betania wúlutɔ, Simon ɔkʋá alalɔ́ ɩlɔ pɛpɛ kɩ wóyítɔ́ ɔdɛ atɔ́ gyí a, ɔtsɩ ɔkʋ lɛ́ba ɩnʋ; ɔdɛ prɛntʋa wankláán kʋá ofobí fánfán ánɩ́ ɩbʋ ibíá bʋ mʋ́tɔ́. Oletií mʋ́ ɔnɔ́, ɔlɛtsɛɩ́ ofobí ámʋ wʋ́lɩ́ Yesu nwuntɔ.
Akʋ bʋbʋ ɩnʋá ɩmɔwa amʋ́ ɔdwɛ. Bɛfɩtɛ́ aba bɛɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ ɔdɛ ofobí ánfɩ yintá?
Tɛkɩ abɛ́talɩ́ fɛ́ ofobí fánfán ánfɩ, mʋ́ ibíá bɔ́dʋn ɔbakʋ́lɛ ofi ɔkʋlɛ ɩkɔká ánfɩ, pʋ́há ahiánfɔ.” Bɛhɩɛ wá ɩyɩn wá ɔtsɩ ámʋ.
Támɛ Yesu lɛ́blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩsi mʋ! Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩdɛ́ mʋ háan? Ɩtɔ yilé alabwɛ́ há mɩ́.
Ahiánfɔ bétsiá mlɩ wá ekekegyíɛkɛ. Brégyíbrɛ́á mlɩdéklé a, mlɛ́talɩ́ wá awɩtɔlɛ há amʋ́, támɛ mɩ́ mʋ́ mméetsiá mlɩtɔ yɔ́.
Alabwɛ́ mʋ́á ɔbɛ́talɩ́ pʋ́lá mɩ́ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ yáɩ́ há mɩ́ opulákɛ́.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ɔtɩ́nɛgyíɔtɩ́nɛ́á bɛ́da Bulu asʋn wankláán ámʋ ɔkan a, bɛ́blɩ́ tɔ́ ánfɩ ɔtsɩ ánfɩ labwɛ́ ánfɩ pʋ́káɩ́n mʋsʋ.”
Yuda Iskariot Lótsulá Ánɩ́ Ɔbɛ́lɛ Yesu Há
Mʋ́ ɔma a, mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Yuda Iskariot lóyówun Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ, mɛ́nɩ ɔbɛ́lɛ Yesu há amʋ́.
Brɛ́á bonu asʋ́n ánfɩ á, ɩlɛhɩɛ wá amʋ́ ɔdwɛ. Bɛhɩɛ mʋ asɩ ánɩ́ bɛ́ka mʋ ɩkɔ. Mʋ́ sʋ olodunká ɔkpa ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́tsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ lɛ́ Yesu há amʋ́.
Katsʋn Atogyihɛ Gyí
Bodobodo Mátúhɛ́Nkɛ ámʋtɔ ɛkɛ gyankpapʋá bʋtɔmɔ́ Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ akúfa lɔ́fʋn. Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Osunápʋ́, obu mɔmʋtɔ ayɛla ha fʋ, afʋgyi Katsʋn Nkɛtɔ atogyihɛ amʋ?”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɔwa amʋ́tɔ́ abanyɔ́, bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩyɔ Yerusalem wúlutɔ, mléfia oyin ɔkʋá ɔsʋ ntsu-ɔlɔ́, mlɩbuo mʋ.
Wóyí oduátɔ́ obówie á, mlɩfɩtɛ wóyí mʋ wie amʋ mlɩaa, ‘Nkʋ́nʋ́ afɔɔ́ ɔswɩɩ́kpá bʋ, ánɩ́ mɩ́a mɩ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ abɛ́ba begyi Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn atogyihɛ amʋ?’
Obósuná mlɩ abansʋ́rʋ yílé kʋá balá mʋ́tɔ́ yáɩ́. Mlɩbwɛ atɔ́ ámʋ yaɩ ɩnʋ.”
Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɔyɔ wúlu amʋtɔ á, bowun tógyítɔ́ alɩ ámʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ámʋ pɛ́pɛ́ɛ́pɛ́, bɔbwɛ Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn atogyihɛ amʋ yáɩ́ ɩnʋ.
Brɛ́á nsaɩntɔ deklúun a, Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bɛba ɩnʋ.
Atɔ́ ámʋ ogyíkpá a, Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa, mlɩtɔ ɔkʋlɛá mɩ́a mʋnyɔ ɩbɩ da ɔlɛpɛtɔ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há.”
Asʋ́n ánfɩ lɛ́hɩɛ han akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ befi asɩ bʋdɛ mʋ fɩtɛ́ ɩkʋlɛ-kʋlɛ bɛɛ, “Mɩ́ nɩ́ lóó?”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩ ahá dúanyɔ ánfɩtɔ ɔkʋlɛá mɩ́a mʋnyɔ ɩbɩ da ɔlɛpɛtɔ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há nɩ́.
Mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nówu fɛ́ alɩá bɔwanlɩ́n tswɩ, támɛ ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há ámʋ ɔgyɔ́wɩ nɩ́. Nɩ́ bʋmetepí kwɩ́ɩ́ mʋ kʋ́ráá á, tɛkɩ ɩbʋ alɛ́ há mʋ.”
Yesu Ntʋ́pwɛ Atogyihɛ Tráhɛ
Brɛ́á bʋdɛ atɔ́ ámʋ gyí a, Yesu lɛ́lɛ bodobodo ipín, ɔlɛda Bulu ɩpán, bíábía mʋ́tɔ́ pʋ́há amʋ́, blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩhɔ, mɩ́ ɔyʋlʋ́ʋ nɩ.”
Ɩnʋ olotsu ntá-ɛwɛ, ɔlɛda Bulu ɩpán, pʋ́há amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bonu.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ obugya nɩ. Mʋ́ Bulu dɛ́pʋsí mʋ ntam
ánɩ́ alaká há ahásʋ nɩ́. Bɛ́tsɛɩ́ mʋ́ wʋ́lɩ́ asɩ ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ lakpan sʋ.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa, mmɛ́ɛtrá nu wáɩn-abí ntá ánfɩ alɩɩ yɔ́fʋn ɛkɛá nónu mʋ́ pɔ́pwɛ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ.”
Benya wá ɩlʋ dá Bulu ɩpán tá alɩ, bɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ Nfɔ-nyíbʋ ámʋsʋ.
Petro Ɔbɔ́swɩɩ́ Ɔbɛ́ɛ Mʋmeyín Yesu
Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩ fɛ́ɛ́ mléyinkí mɩ́ ɔma. Tsúfɛ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋ́n ámʋtɔ bɛɛ, ‘Nɛ́da akúfa ɔkpapʋ́ ámʋ lɛ́dá, mʋ akúfa bɛ́dasáɩ́n.’
Támɛ nɩ́ Bulu ɔkʋ́sʋ́a mɩ tsú afúlitɔ á, négya mlɩ nkpá yɔ́ Galilea ɔmátɔ́.”
Petro lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ beyinkí fʋ́ ɔmá kʋ́ráá á, mɩ́ mʋ́ mméeyinkí ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ fʋ́ bláa. Onyenɩ, asa batɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ ɔnɔ́ tse nyɔ á, fɔ́swɩɩ́ pʋ́ ɩbɩ wá ogyá tse sa fɛɛ fʋmeyín mɩ́.”
Ɩnʋ Petro lɛ́fɩn yabi yi ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ lowu igyi kʋ́ráá á, mméekiná fʋ́ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.” Alɩ kɛ́n atráhɛ amʋ ɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛblɩ́ nɩ́.
Mpáɩbɔ Getsemane
Boyówie ɔtɩnɛkʋá bʋtɛtɩ́ ɩnʋ Getsemane. Mʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩtsia nfɩ, nɔyɔ́bɔ mpáɩ.”
Ɔlɛkpa Petro mʋa Yakobo pʋ́ Yohane buo ɩwɩ. Ɩnʋ asʋ́n lɛhɩɛ́ han mʋ, mʋ ansɩ́ lɛpɛ.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Asʋ́n ɩhɩ́ɛ́ dɛ mɩ́ háan. Ideklé mɔ mɩ́. Mlɩtsia nfɩ, amlɩgyo.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛnatɩ́ yɔ́ nkpá kpalobí, ɔlɛda akpawunu kókóli Bulu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ ɩbɔ́wa alɛ́ á, ha brɛ́ ánfɩ ɩtsʋn mɩsʋ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Abba
Mɩ́ Sɩ́, fʋtɛtálɩ́ bwɛ́ tógyítɔ́. Ha ntá-ɛwɛ ánfɩ
ɩtsʋn mɩsʋ! Támɛ megyí tɔ́á ndeklé, mboún mʋ́á fʋdeklé ɩbá mʋ́tɔ́!”
Oleyinkí bá akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ wá bowun ánɩ́ bʋdɛdɩdɩ. Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ Petro ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Simon, fʋdɛdɩdɩ? Fʋmɛtalɩ́ gyo dɔnhwɩ́rɩ kʋlɛ kpán?
Mlɩgyo amlɩkokoli Bulu, mɛ́nɩ mlɩmóowie ɩsɔ́kɩtɔ. Tsúfɛ́ ɔŋɛ́ ámʋ déklé, támɛ nyankpʋsa lɔ́pɔn.”
Ɔlɛtrá yɔ́bɔ mpáɩ, bláa Bulu asʋn kua kʋlɛ amʋ kɛ́n.
Ɔlɛtrá yinkí ba bowun ánɩ́ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bʋtráa bʋdɛdɩdɩ, tsúfɛ́ dɩdɩ́ dɛ amʋ́ bʋ. Bʋmɛtalɩ́ bláa mʋ asʋansʋ.
Brɛ́á ɔlɛba otse saasɩ a, ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩlatráa si mlɩda mlɩdɛ́ ɔkpʋ́nʋ́ da? Itsía alɩ ngya! Brɛ́ ámʋ lafʋn ánɩ́ bɔ́pʋ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ wá lakpan abwɛpʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ.
Mlɩkʋsʋ ayɔ. Mlɩkɩ, ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔdɛ mɩ́ lɛ há ámʋ ná á!”
Yesu Kɩtá

Yesu ɔnɔ́ mesi asa akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛá bʋtɛtɩ́ mʋ Yuda lóbowie ɩnʋ. Ɔdɔm ánɩ́ bʋdɛ ndayí pʋ́ nkpotí bʋbuo mʋ. Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn, Mose mbla asunápʋ́ pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ lɔ́wa amʋ́.
Yuda amʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛlɛ Yesu há ámʋ lɛ́bláa ɔdɔm amʋ yáɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ nɛ́latá pútá ámʋ gyí ɔhá ámʋ nɩ. Mlɩkɩta mʋ kínkíínkín, amlɩkpa mʋ natɩ.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛnatɩ́ laa yɔ́ Yesu wá, yókpolí mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́!” Ɔlɛlatá mʋ pútá.
Ɩnʋ ahá ámʋ bɛnatɩ́ tʋ́ Yesu, kɩ́tá mʋ kínkíínkín.
Támɛ ɩnʋ alɩɩ́pʋ́ amʋtɔ ɔkʋlɛ lɔ́tswɩ mʋ ɔdayí kpá Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn osúmbi ɔkʋ ɩsʋ lɛ́.
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ogyo otswapʋ́ ngyi, sʋ́ mlɩlatsú nkpotí pʋ́ ndayí mlɛbá mɩ́ ɔkɩtákpá?
Ntsie mlɩ wá Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ ekekegyíɛkɛ, ndɛ mlɩ atɔ́ suná, mlɩmɛ́kɩtá mɩ́ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ. Ɩ́nɩ lahá Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋ ɩlaba mʋ́tɔ́.”
Ɩnʋ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛsrɩ́ sí mʋ.
Ilesi ɔyasubi ɔkʋá ɔlɔwa ligá nkʋlɛ. Bɛkɩtá mʋ,
támɛ ɔlɔkɔlɩ, sí mʋ ligá ámʋ wá amʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ, pʋ́ yayá srɩ́.
Yudafɔ Ahandɛ Ansɩ́tɔ́ Lɩɩ́
Bɛkpa Yesu ya Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn wóyí. Igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn, Mose mbla asunápʋ́ pʋ́ Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bafia ɩnʋ.
Petro lɛ́pɛtɩ́ buo amʋ́ ɔma tsútsúútsú, alɩɩ yówie wóyítɔ́ ɩnʋ. Ɩnʋ oleyétsiá ɩnʋ asúmpʋ́ wá, ɔdɛ ogyá núu.
Ɩnʋ Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Yudafɔ asʋ́n agyípʋ́
atráhɛ fɛ́ɛ́ bodunká ahá ánɩ́ bɛ́ka asʋ́n dɩ́nká Yesusʋ, mɛ́nɩ bɛ́lɩɩ́ amʋ́ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́sʋ mɔ́ mʋ, támɛ bʋmenya.
Tsúfɛ́ ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bɔwa afunu dɩ́nká mʋsʋ, támɛ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ ɔnɔ́ lɔtsʋn ɔtsan.
Ɩnʋ akʋ bɔkʋsʋ́ ká asʋ́n dɩ́nká mʋsʋ bɛɛ,
“Anɩlónuá ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Nóbwie Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa anfɩ bapʋ́ ɩbɩ yi anfɩ, támɛ nkɛnsá ɔma a, nɛ́layi pɔ́pwɛá megyí nyankpʋsa ɔbɔ́pʋ ɩbɩ yi mʋ́.’ ”
Támɛ amʋ́ ɛ́ amʋ́ ɔnɔ́ mɔbwɛ kʋlɛ.
Ɩnʋ Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ lɔ́kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́ amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ ansɩ́tɔ́, ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋma ɔnɔ́ lɛ́? Fʋma asʋansʋ blɩ́ pʋ́lɛ́ fʋ́ ɩwɩ?”
Támɛ Yesu mɛ́lɛ asʋansʋ ɔnɔ́. Mʋ́ʋ́ Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ lɛ́trá fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bulu ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋtɛkánfʋ́ ámʋ mʋ Bi gyí fʋ́? Fʋ́gyí Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu lɛ́da mʋ ofúli amʋ) nɩ?”
Yesu lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ee! Mɩ́ nɩ́! Mlówun ánɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ntsie Bulu Otúmípʋ gyɔpɩsʋ ánfɩ ndɩn nwʋlʋ́táasʋ tsú ɔsʋ́sʋ́ nɛbá.”
Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ lɛ́kɩtá mʋ atadɩɛ bálɩ́ mʋ́ kɩaan.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Adánsɩɛ mɔmʋ anɩtráa anɩgyó?
Mlɩlanú abususʋ ánɩ́ alablɩ́. Nkálɩ gyí mlɩ agywɩɩn?” Amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ botsulá ánɩ́ olegyi pɔ́n, bʋmɔ́ɔ mʋ.

Amʋ́tɔ́ akʋ bɔwa atsʋnɔ́ tutúu wʋlɩ́ mʋ bɩ. Bɔpʋ atɔ́ tin mʋ ansíbi, bɔfʋlɩ́ mʋ atswɛ, bláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́, suna anɩ ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔlɔfʋlɩ́ fʋ́ ɩtswɛ!” Ɩnʋ agyópʋ amʋ ɛ́ bɛdadáa mʋ asʋtɔ.
Petro Lɔ́swɩɩ́ Ɔbɛ́ɛ Mʋmeyín Yesu
Petro lési otsie wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ ɩnʋ, Bulu igyí ɔhapʋ́ dɛhɛn amʋ osúmbi tsɩ́hɛ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́ba.
Brɛ́á olowun Petro tsie ɔdɛ ogyá núu a, ɔlɛkɩ mʋ díín. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ Petro ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́a Yesu Nasaretyin amʋ nyɔ ná.”
Támɛ Petro lɔ́swɩɩ́ blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mmeyín tɔtɔ tsú asʋ́n ánfɩ fʋdɛblɩ́ ánfɩ ɩwɩ!” Ɔlɛnatɩ́ yɛ́lɩɩ́ ɔkpa ɔnɔ́, ɩnʋ batɛ lɔ́bʋn.
Osúmbi tsɩ́hɛ́ ámʋ lɛ́trá yɔ́tʋ mʋ ɩnʋ, ɔlɔwa ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋlɩɩ́ ɩnʋ ámʋ bláa bɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋlɛ gyí oyin ánfɩ.”
Támɛ Petro lɛ́trá swɩɩ́ pʋ́ ɩbɩ wá ogyá. Ɩlɔbwɛ kpalobí á, ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋlɩɩ́ ɩnʋ ámʋ bɛbláa Petro bɛɛ, “Lɛ́lɛ́ mʋ́ á, amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋlɛ fʋgyi, tsúfɛ́ Galileayin fʋ́ ɛ́ fʋ́gyi?”
Ɩnʋ Petro lɔ́wa ntam kakáa bɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɛká tógyítɔ́, mmeyín oyin ánfɩ mlɩdɛ́ mʋ ɩwɩ asʋ́n blɩ́ ánfɩ.”
Ɩnʋ batɛ lɔ́bɔn otse nyɔɔsɩ. Mʋ́ʋ́ Petro lɛ́kaɩ́n asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fɔ́swɩɩ́ tse sa fɛɛ fʋmeyín mɩ́ asa batɛ ɔbɛ́lɛ ɔnɔ́ tse nyɔ.” ámʋsʋ. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛkpa isú yi, hɩ́ɛ́ sú woo.
